parts.name: bed_hammock_spreader_canvas
sources: A bed of 74 by 55 in, 124.5 in long with its cords (Sunnydaze, Double Wide 2-Person Spreader Bar Rope Hammock); a canvas of cotton of 12 oz/yd2 (407 g/m2).
Spreader bars of hardwood of 38 by 20 mm, ten cords to a ring of steel, a chain to the strap (by eye).
